notes: 403 downloads now auto-discover the correct Place ID by checking the asset creator's games and up to 5 of their friends' games
CDN download failures now report the actual HTTP status and reason instead of a generic error
Monetization job skips developer products and gamepasses that already exist by name
Added gamepass and developer product reupload support
App checks for updates on startup and prompts with a notification when a new version is available
Fixed upload failures caused by Roblox API rate limits (HTTP 429)
Extended upload operation timeout from 10s to 90s
Launcher now auto-updates from GitHub releases without needing to be rebuilt
Uploads now automatically target the group when the game is group-owned and the user has upload permissions
No configuration required. Creator type and ID are detected from the active place at scan time
Fixed CDN failures when scanning folders with many sounds in subdirectories
Removed place ID field from app settings, managed by the plugin now
Scanning is now instant (removed sequential marketplace API calls)
Reduced download concurrency to avoid Roblox CDN rate limits
Sound asset download and re-upload via Roblox Open Cloud
Roblox Studio plugin with place ID config, mouse lock, and fast parallel downloads
Session output log with per-sound status and failure breakdown
